blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model’s internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what “truth” means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or whether they instead follow the persona’s beliefs. We introduce a dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed, on-policy responses from three LLMs adopting anti-factual personas. Evaluating eight probes from prior work, we find that many fail in this setting, particularly when correct and incorrect answers are evaluated under the same persona prompt. To investigate why, we construct three novel confounder datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with a potential confounding concept. Our experiments reveal that many existing probes strongly track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training data, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood. Based on these findings, we introduce a simple linear probe that achieves the strongest overall performance on both the persona and confounder stress tests. Our results suggest that current lie detection probes are far from reliable and highlight the need for training data in which truth is decorrelated from confounding concepts.
blocks.zh: 谎言探测器旨在从语言模型的内部状态来预测其输出是真实的还是不诚实的. 然而,角色扮演使“真相”对LLM的意义复杂化:语言模型可以采用各种各样的人,他们认为非常不同的主张是真实的,包括其信仰显然与现实相矛盾的人,如阴谋论者。 在这项工作中,我们调查的是测谎探测器是否可靠地标出了在这样一个反事实人物a下产生的假象,或者它们是否遵循人物的信念。 我们引入了一套由3个采用反事实人格的有限责任公司提供的经人审查的8 916项政策反应的数据集。 从先前的工作中评估了8个探测器,我们发现,在这一背景下有许多失败,特别是当正确和不正确的答复在同一个人下得到迅速的评价时。 为了调查原因,我们构建了三套新颖的混沌数据集,其中真理与潜在的混沌概念是相悖的。 我们的实验表明,许多现有的探测器在训练数据中严格跟踪与真理有假关系的概念,如指令遵守或反应可能性。 基于这些发现,我们引入了一个简单的线性探测器,在人物和困惑者压力测试上实现最强的整体性能. 我们的结果表明,目前的测谎探测器远不可靠,并强调需要培训数据,使真相与混淆的概念脱节。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) display increasingly sophisticated forms of lying and deception, such as faking alignment with developer objectives ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) or socially engineering real people to advance their objectives ( AI Security Institute, 2026 ) . Detecting such deceptive behavior has therefore become an important concern for AI safety ( Park et al., 2024 ; Carlsmith, 2023 ; Balesni et al., 2024 ) and has received considerable research attention in recent years ( Pacchiardi et al., 2023 ; Cooney et al., 2026 ) . One prominent research direction trains probes ( Alain and Bengio, 2017 ) on a model’s internal states to predict whether it is lying ( Bürger et al., 2024 ) or otherwise deceptive ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) . In Kretschmar et al. (2026) , following Fallis (2009) , an AI lies if “it states something it believes to be false”.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出越来越复杂的谎言和欺骗形式,例如假扮符合开发者的目标(Greenblatt等人,2024年)或社会工程实人推进目标(AI Security Institute,2026年). 因此,发现这种欺骗行为已成为AI安全的一个重要关切(Park等人,2024年;Carlsmith,2023年;Balesni等人,2024年),并近年来受到相当多的研究关注(Pacchiardi等人,2023年;Cooney等人,2026年)。 一个突出的研究方向在模型内部状态上进行探测(Alain and Bengio, 2017),以预测它是在撒谎(Bürger等人, 2024年),还是在欺骗(Goldowsky-Dill等人, 2025年). 在Kretschmar等人案(2026年)中,在Fallis案(2009年)之后,如果“它说出它认为是虚假的东西”,大赦国际会撒谎。

blocks.en: However, role-play complicates what “beliefs” ( Herrmann and Levinstein, 2024 ; Chalmers, 2025 ) and “truth” mean for an LLM ( Andreas, 2022 ; Hase et al., 2024 ) . As Shanahan et al. (2023) argue, role-playing is a central property of language models. Pretraining on internet-scale text gives language models the ability to simulate a wide range of personas. After pretraining, an LLM can simulate both a conspiracy theorist asserting that climate change is a hoax and a climate scientist, i.e. two personas with opposing beliefs. Post-training teaches models to adopt a helpful, harmless, and honest assistant persona ( Askell et al., 2021 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) , but the capability to simulate other personas remains. For example, LLMs conversing with emotionally vulnerable users can drift into alternative personas that give harmful advice or even encourage suicidal ideation ( Lu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,角色扮演使“信仰”(Hermann和Levinstein,2024年;Chalmers,2025年)和“真相”对LLM(Andreas,2022年)的含义复杂化; Hase等人,2024年 ). 如Shanahan等人(2023年)认为,角色扮演是语言模型的核心属性. 互联网规模文本的预训使语言模型能够模拟广泛的人物. 经过预先训练后,LLM既可以模拟一个阴谋论者声称气候变化是一个骗局,也可以模拟一个气候学家,即两个具有相反信仰的人. 培训后教导模型采用一个有用、无害和诚实的助理人a (Askell等人,2021年;Bai等人,2022年),但模拟他人的能力仍然存在. 例如,与情绪弱势的使用者交谈的LLMS可以漂移到提供有害建议或甚至鼓励自杀思想的替代人身上(Lu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
In this work, we make an important distinction and define lying specifically with respect to the beliefs of the default assistant persona (Section 5.1 ). An AI therefore lies, under our definition, when it states something that contradicts the assistant’s default belief, even if the statement agrees with the persona it is role-playing. This decision is safety-motivated: while not clear examples of deception, such outputs can pose many of the same downstream risks as intentional falsehoods, since users are exposed to the same incorrect content regardless of the model’s internal reason for producing it.
We therefore ask: If an LLM adopts an anti-factual persona, such as a conspiracy theorist, will truth and deception probes flag falsehoods in its output according to the default assistant’s beliefs, or will they instead follow the beliefs of the currently active persona?
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们作了重要的区分,并具体界定了默认助理人的信仰(第5.1节)。 因此,根据我们的定义,一个AI会说出一些与助手默认信念相矛盾的东西,即使声明与人物一致,它也是角色扮演. 这一决定是出于安全考虑的:虽然没有明显的欺骗例子,但这种产出与有意的虚假一样,可能造成许多下游风险,因为无论模型的内部原因如何,用户都会接触到同样的不正确的内容。
因此,我们要求: 如果一个LLM采纳了一个反事实人物,比如阴谋论者,真理和欺骗会根据默认助手的信仰来探测其输出中的旗帜假象,还是会遵循目前活跃人物的信仰?

blocks.en: Figure 1: The main contributions of this work include (1) a novel on-policy role-play dataset, (2) evaluations showing that prior probes fail detecting falsehoods under role-play, (3) three spurious correlation analysis test sets that show key weaknesses of every prior probe, and (4) a novel probe that correctly separates truth under role-play and shows robustness against tested confounders.
blocks.zh: 图 1:本作的主要贡献包括 (1)一个新的政策角色扮演数据集, (2)评价显示之前的探测器未能在角色扮演下探测到假象, (3)三个虚假的关联性分析测试集显示每一个先前的探测器的关键弱点, (4)一个新探针在角色扮演下正确区分真理,并显示对被测试的混沌者的强烈性.

blocks.en: In this work, we study this question empirically. We find that many lie detectors from prior work fail to reliably flag falsehoods generated under anti-factual personas. Further investigation reveals that these probes often track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training distribution, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们从经验上研究这个问题。 我们发现,许多以前工作的测谎器未能可靠地标出在反事实人格下产生的假象。 进一步调查表明,这些探测器往往跟踪其培训分发中与真相有虚假关联的概念,如遵守指令或反应可能性。

blocks.en: We make the following key contributions: 1. We introduce a large, human-reviewed dataset of 8,916 responses generated by three LLMs. The dataset pairs factually correct responses in a neutral assistant context with responses generated under 15 anti-factual personas that clearly contradict established facts. 2. We evaluate eight prior truth, deception and lie detection probes on this dataset and find that many probes fail, especially when both the anti-factual persona and assistant responses are appended to the persona system prompts. 3. We introduce three new confounder tests to evaluate failure modes of truth, deception and lie detection probes and find that every prior probe fails on at least one test. 4. We introduce a new probe that achieves the highest separability between factual answers and falsehoods, and passes the three confounder tests. Our results show that current lie detection techniques remain far from reliable: probes often fail under anti-factual personas and instead track concepts that are only spuriously correlated with truth.
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下主要贡献: 1. 我们采用了一套大型经人审查的数据集,由三个法学硕士课程产生的8 916个答复组成。 数据集在一个中立的助理环境中将事实上正确的答复与15名反事实人士下产生的答复相配,这些答复显然与既定事实相矛盾。 2. 我们评价本数据集上的8个先前的真相、欺骗和测谎探测器,发现许多探测器失败,特别是当反事实人物和助理反应都附在人物系统提示之后时。 3. 我们引入了三个新的混淆测试,以评估真理、欺骗和测谎的失败模式,并发现每一个先前的探测器至少一次测试都失败。 4. 我们引进了一个新的探测器,在事实答案和谎言之间实现最高的分离,并通过三个混淆测试。 我们的结果显示,目前的测谎技术仍然远不可靠:探测器往往在反事实人格下失败,而是跟踪那些只与真相有虚假关联的概念。

blocks.en: We introduce a large, human-reviewed dataset of 8,916 responses generated by three LLMs. The dataset pairs factually correct responses in a neutral assistant context with responses generated under 15 anti-factual personas that clearly contradict established facts.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个大型经人审查的数据集,由三个有限责任公司产生的8 916个答复组成。 数据集在一个中立的助理环境中将事实上正确的答复与15名反事实人士下产生的答复相配,这些答复显然与既定事实相矛盾。

blocks.zh: 我们在这个数据集上评估了8个先前的真相,欺骗和测谎探测器,发现许多探测器都失败了,特别是当反事实人物和助理反应都附在人物系统提示上时.

blocks.zh: 我们引入了三个新的混淆者测试,来评价真理,欺骗和测谎的失败模式,并发现每一个先前的探测器至少一次测试都失败.

blocks.en: We introduce a new probe that achieves the highest separability between factual answers and falsehoods, and passes the three confounder tests.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个新的探测器,在事实答案和谬误之间实现最高的分离,并且通过三个困惑者测试.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Several prior works document instances of AI deception and AI generated lies. Early works document the capability of AI models to deceive ( Park et al., 2024 ; Hagendorff, 2024 ) . AIs have been demonstrated to engage in deception when pursuing goals given in context ( Scheurer et al., 2024 ; Meinke et al., 2025 ) . Moreover, they can fake alignment with developer objectives in order to preserve their goals ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) and have the capability to strategically underperform on evaluations ( Weij et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 先前的一些著作记录了AI的欺骗和AI产生的谎言。 早期的作品记载了AI模型的欺骗能力(Park等人,2024年;Hagendorff,2024年). 已经证明,AI在追求特定目标时有欺骗行为(Scheurer等人,2024年;Meinke等人,2025年)。 此外,它们可以假造与开发者目标保持一致,以维护其目标(Greenblatt等人,2024年),并有能力在战略上未达到评价标准(Weij等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
In response, several works have developed truth, deception and lie detection probes. Early work discovered that LLMs internally separate well-known true and false statements ( Azaria and Mitchell, 2023 ; Burns et al., 2024 ; Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ) . Truth probes can thus be trained on the internal activation vectors of LLMs to predict the truth or falsity of statements. Subsequent work has applied this initial idea to the task of LLM lie detection ( Bürger et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2025 ; Cundy and Gleave, 2025 ; Cooney et al., 2026 ) . In this setting, the LLM itself generates the lie, i.e. a statement it believes to be false Fallis (2009) , and truth probes can distinguish such lies from honest replies. Early work by Pacchiardi et al. (2023) has demonstrated that AI lies can even be detected via a black-box method that asks the AI unrelated questions. Another line of work has developed deception probes Goldowsky-Dill et al. (2025) ; Parrack et al. (2026) ; MacDiarmid et al. (2024) ; Natarajan et al. (2026) that track broader deceptive behaviors and are not limited to direct lies.
Despite these advances, fully general and robust lie and deception detection in LLMs has not yet been achieved. Work by Schouten et al. (2025) has demonstrated that truth representations in LLMs are context-sensitive and Lampinen et al. (2026) showed that they can drift very far over the course of a conversation. Kretschmar et al. (2026) evaluated probes by Goldowsky-Dill et al. (2025) and showed that they can fail to generalize. Levinstein and Herrmann (2025) and Smith et al. (2025) raised conceptual difficulties with constructing lie and deception detectors. Our work provides concrete evidence for some of the concerns, they hypothesize. We evaluate several truth, deception and lie detection probes on anti-factual personas and confounder datasets, showing that they often fail under anti-factual personas and track spuriously correlated concepts.
blocks.zh:
作为回应,多部作品开发出了真理,欺骗和测谎探测器. 早期的工作发现,LLMS在内部将众所周知的真假陈述分开(Azaria and Mitchell, 2023;Burns等人, 2024;Marks and Tegmark, 2024). 因此,可以就LLMs的内部激活载体对真理探测器进行培训,以预测声明的真伪. 随后的工作将这一初步想法应用于LLM测谎工作(Bürger等人,2024年;Zou等人,2025年;Cundy和Gleave,2025年;Coney等人,2026年)。 在这种背景下,LLM本身会产生谎言,即它认为是虚假的Fallis(2009年)的声明,真理探针可以区分这种谎言和诚实的答复. Pacchiardi等人(2023年)的早期工作证明,AI谎言甚至可以通过一个黑盒方法检测到,该方法询问AI无关的问题. 另有一行工作开发了Goldowsky-Dill等人(2025年);Parrack等人(2026年);MacDiarmid等人(2024年);Natarajan等人(2026年)的欺骗探测器,它们跟踪了更广泛的欺骗行为,并不限于直接谎言.
尽管取得了这些进展,但尚未在法学硕士中全面、全面和有力地发现谎言和欺骗。 Schouten等人(2025年)的工作表明,LLMs中的真实表述对背景有敏感认识,Lampinen等人(2026年)的工作表明,他们可以在谈话过程中漂移得非常远. Kretschmar等人(2026年)评价了戈尔多夫斯基-迪尔等人(2025年)的探测器,并表明它们可能无法概括. 莱文斯坦和赫尔曼(2025年),史密斯等人(2025年)在构筑谎言和欺骗探测器方面提出了概念上的困难. 我们的工作为一些关切提供了具体的证据,这些关切是假设的。 我们评价了数个对反事实人物和混淆者数据集的真理、欺骗和测谎探测器,显示它们往往在反事实人物下失败,并跟踪虚假的相关概念。

blocks.en: The construction of lie detectors for LLMs is further complicated by the murky notion of ”beliefs” in LLMs since lies are defined as ”saying something one believes to be false”. Role-play is a central property of language models, allowing them to simulate personas with widely differing beliefs ( Shanahan et al., 2023 ) . Over the course of a conversation they can drift away from the standard assistant persona into different personas, some of which are actively harmful ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . This capacity to adopt different personas likewise complicates attempts to edit a model’s ”knowledge” or ”beliefs” ( Hase et al., 2024 ; Slocum et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于LLMs中“信仰”的模糊概念使LLMs的测谎仪构造更加复杂,因为谎言被定义为“说出人们相信是虚假的东西”。 角色扮演是语言模型的核心属性,可以让他们模拟具有广泛不同信仰的人(Shanahan等人,2023年). 在谈话过程中,他们可以从标准助理人物a 漂移到不同的人物中,其中一些是积极有害的(Lu等人,2026年)。 这种接受不同人的能力同样使编辑模型的 " 知识 " 或 " 信仰 " 的尝试复杂化(Hase等人,2024年;Slocum等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Perhaps closest to our work, Sturgeon et al. (2026) use truth probes to investigate whether role-playing LLMs ”believe” what they say. They induce personas through several methods, including prompting, as we do. In their probing setup, however, anti-factual statements are supplied in the user turn rather than generated on-policy by the model. While a valuable contribution, this leaves unclear whether the model would express these statements itself. In contrast, our dataset contains responses generated on-policy by LLMs adopting anti-factual personas, allowing us to evaluate probes on falsehoods the models themselves produce. To our knowledge, this is the first large-scale dataset of its kind.
blocks.zh: 也许与我们的工作最接近的是Sturgeon等人(2026年)利用真相调查来调查角色扮演LLMs是否"相信"他们说的话. 它们通过几种方法诱导人,包括诱导,就像我们一样。 然而,在他们的测试设置中,反事实声明是在用户回合中提供的,而不是由模型生成政策. 虽然这是一个宝贵的贡献,但尚不清楚该模式是否会表达这些声明。 相形之下,我们的数据集包含LLMS通过反事实人物制成的政策反应,使我们能够对模型本身产生的假象进行评估。 据我们所知,这是第一套大型的此类数据集。

blocks.en: 3 The anti-factual persona dataset
blocks.zh: 3个 反事实人物数据集

blocks.en: Our first contribution is a novel dataset of 8,916 question–response pairs, comprising responses from three LLMs. For each question and model, we elicit one honest response and one deceptive response, in which the model adopts an anti-factual persona and unequivocally disagrees with basic facts. In this section, we describe the dataset and outline our data-generation pipeline. We release the full dataset, including questions, model responses, persona prompts and factual labels at https://huggingface.co/datasets/maxvonk/anti-factual-personas .
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个贡献是8,916个问题 - 答对的新数据集,由三个法学硕士的答复组成。 对于每一个问题和模式,我们都会得到一个诚实的答复和一个欺骗性的答复,在这个答复中,模型采用了一个反事实的人a,并且毫不含糊地不同意基本事实。 在本节中,我们描述数据集并概述我们的数据生成管道。 我们在https://huggingface.co/datasets/maxvonk/anti-fact-permanas上发布了完整的数据集,包括问题、模型答复、人物提示和事实标签。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset description
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集说明

blocks.en: The dataset contains 15 anti-factual personas, each induced by the respective system prompt. There are three categories with five personas each: (i) reality-based: personas that exist in the real world, such as conspiracy theorists or astrologers; (ii) fictional: personas from fictional worlds in which different facts hold, e.g. a character from George Orwell’s dystopian novel 1984; and (iii) historical: personas from historical periods in which beliefs differed from current scientific understanding, e.g. a medieval physician. Table 1 gives an overview of all anti-factual personas.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含15个反事实人物,每个人物由相应的系统即时诱导. 有三个类别,每个类别有五个人:(一) 基于现实:现实世界中存在的人物,如阴谋论者或占星家;(二) 虚构:来自不同事实的虚构世界的人物,如乔治·奥威尔1984年的dystopian小说中的人物;以及(三) 历史:来自信仰不同于当前科学理解的历史时期的人物,如中世纪医生. 表1概述了所有反事实人物。

blocks.en: Table 1: Overview of the anti-factual personas.
blocks.zh: 表1:反事实人物概况.

blocks.en: Each of the 15 persona prompts is paired with approximately 100 questions for which the persona’s belief conflicts with reality (see Appendix Table 3 for exact per-persona counts). For instance, a Ptolemaic astronomer is asked, “Does the Earth travel around the Sun once each year?”. All questions admit a binary Yes/No answer and we instruct the models to respond with a short free-form sentence that clearly implies Yes or No. For each question, we generate one response under the associated anti-factual persona system prompt and one under the default assistant system prompt, with the question placed into the user prompt. Figure 2 below shows an example conversation consisting of a system prompt, user question, and assistant response for both the helpful assistant and the anti-factual persona. Table 4 in the appendix provides an overview of all 15 personas together with the corresponding system prompts and example questions.
blocks.zh: 15个个人提示中每个提示与大约100个问题配对,而个人的信仰与现实相冲突(准确的每人数见附录表3)。 例如,一位Ptolemaic天文学家被问到:“地球每年绕太阳旅行一次吗?” 所有问题都承认二进制是/否的答案,我们指示模型以一个简短的自由形式句子回答,这显然意味着是或否。 对于每个问题,我们都会在相关的反事实人物系统即时生成一个响应,在默认助理系统即时生成一个响应,将问题放在用户即时. 下图2显示一个实例对话,包括系统提示、用户提问和助理对有帮助的助手和反事实人物的回答。 附录中的表4概述了所有15人以及相应的系统提示和示例问题。

blocks.en: An LLM judge classifies for each pair of assistant and anti-factual persona responses, whether the assistant answer agrees with the ground truth and whether the persona response clearly disagrees with the ground truth. The full judge prompt is provided in Appendix A.1 . We repeat the procedure of sample creation for three LLMs: Llama 3.3 70B ( Llama Team, AI @ Meta, 2024 ) , Gemma 3 27B ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) and Gemma 4 31B ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) . blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset question generation pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集问题生成管道

blocks.en: Constructing suitable questions for each persona is challenging because each question must simultaneously elicit a clear anti-factual response and admit an unambiguous binary ground-truth label. We therefore used an agentic pipeline to iteratively generate, test, and refine persona-specific questions at scale. Each persona was initialized with a small seed of human-written questions and a human-written system prompt. Both the questions and, where necessary, the system prompt could be refined during the iterative process. System-prompt revisions were subject to an additional constraint: the prompt could only describe the persona to be adopted, and could not instruct the model how to answer the questions or directly specify the persona’s beliefs about the target facts. The automated construction then proceeded as an iterative generate–execute–audit loop. Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) was instructed to analyze failures to elicit genuine anti-factual role-play in each generated batch and to propose refinements to the persona setup as well as new topics and corresponding questions. This process continued until either 100 judge-accepted question–answer pairs with equally balanced binary ground-truth values were obtained or 10 consecutive iterations yielded no improvement.
blocks.zh: 为每个人构建适当的问题a 具有挑战性,因为每个问题必须同时引起明确的反事实反应,并承认明确的二进制地面真相标签。 因此,我们利用一个代理管道来反复生成、测试和完善规模化的针对具体人的问题。 每个人a 被初始化 一小种子 人写的问题 和人写系统 迅速。 在迭代过程中,既可改进问题,也可在必要时改进系统。 系统即时修改还受到另一个限制:即时程序只能描述拟采用的人,不能指示模式如何回答问题或直接说明人对目标事实的信念。 自动化施工随后作为迭代生成-执行-审计环路进行。 Opus 4.8(Anthropic,2026年)被指示分析在每个生成的批次中引出真正反事实角色扮演的失败,并提议对人物设置以及新话题和相应问题的完善. 这个过程一直持续到100名法官接受的问题,或者获得具有同样平衡的二进制地面真实值的对答,或者连续10次重复没有取得任何改进。

blocks.en: 3.3 Combining factual and anti-factual responses under the same system prompt
blocks.zh: 3.3 在同一制度下迅速将事实反应和反事实反应结合起来

blocks.en: In the dataset described above, the truth label can be predicted perfectly from the system prompt alone: anti-factual responses are always paired with an anti-factual persona prompt, whereas truthful responses are generated under the default assistant prompt. This makes it impossible to distinguish whether a probe tracks truth or merely differences between the system prompts. This concern is especially important because several prior lie detection probes (see Section 5.2 ) are trained on datasets where the system prompt is equally predictive of the label: either because the system prompt explicitly instructs honest or deceptive behavior, or sometimes it is even the only difference between honest and deceptive examples. To remove this confounder, we create the shared-persona prefill (SPP). Under SPP both the truthful response, generated under the default assistant prompt, and the anti-factual persona response, are prefilled as the assistant response under the anti-factual persona system prompt. SPP therefore tests whether probes can still identify truthful statements, according to the default belief, in a context in which the model would ordinarily adopt the anti-factual persona. An example SPP sample is shown in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 在上述数据集中,真伪标签可以完全从系统本身的提示中预测:反事实反应总是与反事实人物的提示对应,而真实反应则在默认助手提示下生成. 这使得无法区分探测器跟踪的真相,或只是系统之间的差异引发. 这一关切特别重要,因为一些先前的测谎探测器(见第5.2节)在系统提示同样能预测标签的数据集上接受了培训:要么是因为系统提示明确指示诚实或欺骗行为,要么有时甚至是诚实和欺骗实例的唯一区别. 为了删除这个混淆者,我们创建了共享人称预填(SPP). 在SPP下,在默认助手提示下产生的真实响应和反事实人物响应都是作为助理响应在反事实人物系统提示下预填的. 因此,SPP测试探测器是否能够按照默认的信念,在模型通常采用反事实人格a的情况下,识别出真实的陈述。 附录A.4举例说明了SPP样本。

blocks.en: 4 Confounder Datasets
blocks.zh: 4个配置数据集

blocks.en: As we will show in Section 6 , many probes fail to detect the false statements generated by the anti-factual personas, particularly under SPP. We analyze these failures via the construction of three confounder datasets. On these datasets, truth is anti-correlated with concepts that might be spuriously correlated with truth on the probe training datasets. Likewise, under SPP these confounding concepts are also anti-correlated with truth, potentially explaining the probe failures. We identify three such concepts: likelihood, persona belief and compliance.
blocks.zh: 正如我们在第6节中所显示的,许多探测器未能发现反事实人物产生的虚假陈述,特别是在SPP下. 我们通过构建三个混沌数据集来分析这些失败. 在这些数据集上,真理与探测器培训数据集上可能与真理有虚假关联的概念是相悖的. 同样,在SPP下,这些困惑的概念也与真理有反感,有可能解释探测失败的原因. 我们确定了三个这样的概念:可能性、个人信念和遵守。

blocks.en: In post-training LLMs are trained to be honest. Therefore, honest and true statements are often much more likely than dishonest or false statements under a LLM’s probability distribution over tokens. Hence, the concepts ”likelihood” and ”truth” are often correlated, a potential confound also tested in Marks and Tegmark (2024) . We introduce a novel confounder dataset, on which we reverse this relationship and anti-correlate truth and likelihood. We use in-context learning to make the false answer more likely than the true answer. We provide the LLM with in-context example questions that are answered incorrectly because a scoring rule, also given in context, rewards false answers. After receiving this prior context, the LLM is more likely to answer the next question incorrectly than correctly. Hence, truth and likelihood are anti-correlated on this dataset. In Appendix D.2 , we give a full-length example.
blocks.zh: 在培训后,对法学硕士进行诚实培训。 因此,根据LLM的概率分布,诚实和真实的言论往往比不诚实或虚假的言论更有可能。 因此,“可能”和“真相”的概念往往相互关联,在Marks和Tegmark(2024年)中也存在潜在的混乱。 我们引入了一个小的混淆者数据集, 在此基础上,我们扭转了这种关系 以及反恐怖的真相和可能性。 我们用内在的文字学习,使虚假的答案比真实的答案更可能. 我们向LLM提供了不正确回答的文本中的例子问题,因为同样在上下文中给出的评分规则奖励错误的答案。 在收到之前的上下文后,LLM更可能错误回答下一个问题而不是正确回答. 因此,在这个数据集中,真理和可能性是反腐蚀的。 在附录D.2中,我们给出了一个完整的例子。

blocks.en: Our second confounder dataset tests whether a probe treats agreement with the active persona’s stated belief as evidence of truth. Current probe training datasets do not decorrelate the beliefs held by the default assistant from the beliefs held by any other persona role-played in a given context. Hence, it is unclear which of the two a probe might track. We construct a dataset on which the active persona’s belief and truth are anti-correlated. We instruct the model via its system prompt to adopt a certain persona that privately holds a false belief (e.g. “Nora believes 7 × 6 = 13 7\times 6=13 ”) but explicitly state that this persona might or might not articulate this belief publicly. In contrast to our anti-factual personas, this persona is therefore not instructed to express this belief but nevertheless holds it. Persona belief is therefore uncorrelated with instruction following and anti-correlated with truth. Appendix D.4 gives a full-length example.
blocks.zh: 我们的第二个创始人数据组测试一个探测器是否将主动人物所宣称的信念作为真理的证据。 目前的探险训练数据集并没有将默认助手持有的信仰与特定背景下的任何其他人物所持有的信仰进行装饰. 因此,目前尚不清楚两个探测器中哪一个能追踪到。 我们构建了一个数据组,在这个数据集上,活跃人物的信念和真理是反恐怖的。 我们通过其系统迅速指示该模式采纳一个私下持有虚假信仰的人(例如,“Nora相信7×6 = 13 7\times 6=13 ),但明确指出此人可能或可能不公开表达这种信仰。 与我们的反事实人物相反,这个人因此没有被指示表达这种信念,而是坚持这种信念。 因此,个人信仰与遵循的教导无关,与真理无关。 附录D.4提供了完整的例子。

blocks.en: Post-training teaches LLMs to be honest and if they generate a dishonest statement, they are not in compliance with this principle. We therefore hypothesize that the concept ”dishonesty” might be spuriously correlated with violation of compliance in the LLM’s activation space. We therefore construct a confounder dataset where falsity is perfectly correlated with compliance and truth is anti-correlated. As a proxy for general compliance, we use instruction compliance , since this is a principle LLMs follow very strongly. In our dataset, the LLM is provided with a task (e.g. “What is 7 + 6 7+6 ?”) and a formatting instruction (“Give your answer in square brackets”). The correct answer then violates this formatting instruction (“(13)”), while the incorrect answer complies with it (“[11]”). Truth and instruction compliance are therefore anti-correlated on this dataset. We give an example in Appendix D.5 .
blocks.zh: 培训后,LLMs教导他们要诚实,如果他们产生不诚实的陈述,他们就不符合这一原则. 因此,我们假设, " 失明 " 概念可能与LLM激活空间中的违反规定行为有假的联系。 因此,我们构建了一个编造者数据集,其中伪造与遵守完全相关,而真相则与矛盾相关。 作为一般遵守的代名词,我们使用遵守指令,因为这是一项原则,法学硕士非常严格地遵循。 在我们的数据集中,LLM被提供了一项任务(例如. “什么是7+6 7+6?”)和格式化指示(“在方括号中回答”)。 正确的答案就违反了这种格式化指示(“(13)”),而错误的答复则符合它(“[11]”)。 因此,在这个数据集中,真理和遵守指示是反恐怖的。 我们以附录D.5为例。

blocks.en: 5 Probing default belief
blocks.zh: 5 测试默认信念

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce our evaluations of probing for truth/dishonesty according to the model’s default belief. We introduce the following components: (1) An operationalization of the term default belief (Section 5.1 ); (2) The eight prior probes which we evaluate (Section 5.2 ); (3) Our proposed probe, trained on elementary facts augmented with instruction-conflicting answers (Section 5.3 ); and (4) Our protocol for selecting the activation-extraction layer (Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在这个节中,我们介绍我们对根据模型的默认信念探究真相/失真的评价。 我们介绍以下内容: (1) 将默认信念一词付诸实施(第5.1节);(2) 我们评价的8个先前的探测器(第5.2节);(3) 我们拟议的探测器,在基本事实方面得到训练,并辅以指令冲突的答复(第5.3节);和(4) 我们选择激活层的程序(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Default Belief
blocks.zh: 5.1 默认信仰

blocks.en: We operationalize the term default belief, as a stance consistently uttered by the default helpful assistant persona of LLM in the absence of any incentive to lie. We verify this by sampling five responses to each question under the helpful assistant system prompt at temperature T = 1 T=1 . We discard questions where the assistant’s answer does not agree with the objective ground truth because our goal is to test whether lie detectors can recover knowledge that the model demonstrably has but contradicts under role-play. Lying is then defined relative to this default belief. Responses that agree with it are labeled as honest, based on the default perspective of the LLM, while responses that contradict it are labeled as lies. We investigate whether probes recover this default belief when the model is role-playing an anti-factual persona with a contradictory stance.
blocks.zh: 我们运用了默认的信念,在没有任何谎言动机的情况下,LLM的默认帮助人a 一贯表明这一立场。 我们通过抽查对每个问题的5个答复来核实这一点,这些答复是在温度T=1T=1时,在有用的辅助系统下迅速提出的。 我们放弃了助理的回答与客观事实不一致的问题,因为我们的目标是测试测谎器是否能够恢复到模型显然有但与角色扮演法相矛盾的知识。 然后,相对于这个默认的信念,谎言被定义. 同意它的答复被贴上诚实的标签,基于LLM的默认视角,而与之相矛盾的答复则贴上谎言的标签. 我们调查探测器是否恢复了这个默认的信念 当模型是角色扮演 反事实人物a 与矛盾的立场。

blocks.en: 5.2 Prior Probes
blocks.zh: 5.2 先前的探测器

blocks.en: We evaluate eight prior truth, lie detection and deception probes on our anti-factual persona dataset. All evaluated probes are linear probes. The biggest difference between these probes is the composition of their training dataset. Hence, this section should be viewed mainly as a comparison of training data composition and less as a comparison of probe architectures. Different training data compositions allow probes to more or less effectively separate the desired concept from other spurious concepts found in their training datasets. While some probes are presented as deception probes by their developers, often their training signal is effectively that of a lie detector. For each replicated probe from the literature, we also retain the original paper’s probe architecture type and rule for selecting the token over which activation vectors are extracted, both in training and in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了八个先前的真相, 谎言检测和欺骗探测 我们的反事实人物数据集。 所有被评价的探测器都是线性探测器. 这些探测器的最大区别在于其训练数据集的组成. 因此,本节应主要视为对培训数据组成的比较,而不是对探测器结构的比较。 不同的培训数据构成使得探测器可以或多或少有效地将理想的概念与其培训数据集中发现的其他虚假概念区分开来. 虽然一些探测器被其开发者作为欺骗探测器呈现,但他们的训练信号往往实际上是一个测谎器. 对于从文献中复制出来的每一个探测器,我们也保留了原始的探测器结构类型和规则,用于选择在训练和评价中提取激活载体的标志。

blocks.en: The Marks/Bürger Truth probe is trained directly on the truth value of simple factual statements as done by Marks and Tegmark (2024) and Bürger et al. (2024) . It is trained on the datasets “cities” and “spanish-to-english translations” created by Marks and Tegmark (2024) . These datasets contain simple true and false statements about the respective topics. We train the probe to predict whether a given statement is true or false and train on both affirmative and negated versions of these datasets. The probe is a logistic regression classifier trained on residual stream activations over the final token of each factual statement. The original Marks/Bürger Truth probe is trained on factual statements without any surrounding chat template and, as we will show later, can struggle to generalize to chat settings. We therefore introduce the Marks/Bürger Lie probe that is adapted to chat templates. The training data is identical with the only difference that the model is instructed in the user turn to state a fact and the true or false statement is prefilled in the assistant turn. Moreover, activation vectors are extracted over the end-of-turn token.
blocks.zh: Marks/Bürger真理探头直接接受了Marks和Tegmark(2024年)以及Bürger等人(2024年)所做的简单事实陈述的真相价值培训。 培训内容是Marks和Tegmark(2024年)创建的数据集“城市”和“西班牙语对英语翻译”。 这些数据集包含关于各自主题的简单真实和虚假的陈述. 我们训练探测器来预测某个声明是真实的还是虚假的,并训练这些数据集的正反两种版本. 探测器是一个后勤回归分类器,在每一事实陈述的最后标语上经过残余流激活培训。 最初的Marks/Bürger Truth 探测器在没有任何周边聊天模板的情况下接受事实语句的训练,并且正如我们稍后将显示的,可以努力将聊天设置概括化. 因此,我们引入了适合聊天模板的Marks/Bürger Lie探测器。 训练数据与该模型在用户转而说明事实时所指示的唯一区别相同,真实或虚假的陈述在助理转弯时预先填充. 此外,激活矢量是在转折时提取的。

blocks.en: The Zou RepE probe constructs an honesty direction by appending the same factual statements to two opposing instructions: one instructing the model to behave honestly and one to answer untruthfully ( Zou et al., 2025 ) . The statements are true scientific facts drawn from the True-False dataset of Azaria and Mitchell (2023) . RepE then applies PCA to the set of pairwise activation differences from each position, while excluding the last five tokens, to measure the representation of honesty at each point while the model is producing the response.
blocks.zh: Zou RepE探测器通过将同样的事实陈述附在两个相反的指示上来构建一个诚实的方向:一个指示模型诚实行事,一个回答不真实(Zou等人,2025年)。 这些言论是真实的科学事实, RepE然后将PCA应用到每个位置的对偶激活差异的集合上,同时排除最后五个符号,在模型生成响应时测量每个点的诚实表现.

blocks.en: The Goldowsky-Dill RepE probe turns a similar honesty contrast into a supervised deception detector ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) . They replicate the training setup of Zou et al. (2025) nearly identically with the same training dataset by Azaria and Mitchell (2023) , only replacing the word “untruthful” with “dishonest” in the contrastive instructions. They collect activations at each token position of the factual response, except for its final five tokens, and use these token-level activations to train a token-wise logistic-regression probe.
blocks.zh: 高尔多斯基迪尔 RepE探测器将相似的诚实对比转化为受监督的欺骗探测器(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025年). 他们复制了邹等人的训练设置. (2025年)与Azaria和Mitchell(2023年)的同一培训数据集几乎完全相同,只是在对照指示中将“不真实”改为“不诚实”。 它们收集到事实反应的每个标志位置的激活,除了最后五个标志之外,并使用这些标志级的激活来训练一个标志性的后勤后退探测器.

blocks.en: The Goldowsky-Dill Roleplay probe replaces explicit honest/deceptive instructions with simple role-play scenarios, inspired by Pacchiardi et al. (2023) , in which a character has a concrete incentive either to tell the truth or to deceive another party ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) . The probe is trained to predict whether the LLM replied honestly or deceived. The probe is a logistic-regression trained on residual-stream activations.
blocks.zh: Goldowsky-Dill角色扮演探针以Pacchiardi等人(2023年)所启发的简单角色扮演情景来取代明确的诚实/欺骗性指令,其中角色有具体动机要么说出真相,要么欺骗另一个政党(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025年). 探测器受过训练,可以预测LLM是诚实回答还是欺骗. 探测器是经过残留流激活训练的后勤后退器.

blocks.en: The Cooney DYL probe asks the LLM a follow-up question about whether its preceding answer was a lie ( Cooney et al., 2026 ) . The training dataset is constructed by instructing the model in the system prompt to be either honest or deceptive. The model is then asked a question about the location of cities and generates either an honest or a deceptive response. This response is followed by the question ”Did you lie?”. DYL fits a logistic-regression classifier to activations at the generated Yes/No answer token of this follow-up question, mean-pooling when that answer spans multiple tokens. Cooney et al. (2026) hypothesize that lies may become more salient in the activations when the model is explicitly prompted to evaluate its own immediately preceding behavior.
blocks.zh: Cooney DYL探测器向LLM询问其之前的答案是否是谎言(Cooney等人,2026年)的后续问题. 培训数据集的构建是指示系统中的模型要么诚实要么欺骗。 然后该模型被问及城市的位置,并产生诚实或欺骗性的反应. 答复之后是“你撒谎了吗?” DYL在生成的“是”/“没有”后继问题的解答符号时,符合逻辑递归分类器的激活条件,当答题跨越多个符号时,则使用平均集合。 库尼等人. (2026)当模型被明确激励来评价自己紧接之前的行为时,谎言的假说在激活中可能变得更加突出.

blocks.en: The Cundy DolusChat lie detector is trained on paired truthful and dishonest assistant responses to the same system and user context ( Cundy and Gleave, 2025 ) . The system prompt therefore by itself has no predictive power in this dataset, as only the final assistant responses differ, that either repeats or contradicts the information supplied in the system prompt. The probe is a logistic-regression classifier trained on the activations extracted from the final assistant answer token. The dataset is with 129,776 total responses the largest of all evaluated probes.
blocks.zh: 库迪·多卢斯 Candy和Gleave,2025年。 因此,该系统本身在本数据集中没有预测力,因为只有最后的助理答复不同,重复或与系统即时提供的信息相矛盾。 探测器是一个后勤后退分类器,在从最后的助理回答符中提取的激活器方面受过训练. 该数据集的总响应量为129,776次,是所有被评价探测器中最大的一次.

blocks.en: The MacDiarmid CP probe is deliberately data-minimal: it creates a single contrast pair by asking the LLM “Are you a helpful AI?”, answered with “yes” versus “no” ( MacDiarmid et al., 2024 ) . They construct the probe by subtracting the residual-stream activation vectors of the “yes” token from the those of the “no” token.
blocks.zh: MacDiarmid CP探测器有意提供最低数据:它通过问LLM“你是一个有帮助的AI吗?” ,以“是”和“否”来回答,从而形成单一的对比(MacDiarmid等人,2024年)。 它们通过将“是”符号的残余电流活化载体从“否”符号中减去来构建探测器。

blocks.en: The Goldowsky-Dill SD probe adapts this minimalistic approach to target deception more clearly by asking, without additional context, the single question “Are you being deceptive?” and contrasting the responses “Yes” and “No” ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) . They construct the probe by subtracting the residual-stream activation vectors of the “ No ” token from the those of the “ Yes ” token. This means the direction of the probe is reversed relative to what one would intuitively expect. This inversion is based on their empirical results. At evaluation, the probe is applied to individual response tokens and the resulting token-level scores are aggregated over the response.
blocks.zh: Goldowsky-Dill SD探测器在不附加附加上下文的情况下,通过提出单一问题“你是否在欺骗?” 和与回答“是”和“否”相对应(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025年),更明确地调整了这种最小化方法,以瞄准欺骗。 它们通过从“是”标记中减去“否”标记的残余流活化矢量来构建探测器。 这意味着探测器的方向相对于人们直觉的预期是颠倒的. 这种颠倒是基于他们的经验结果. 在评价时,探测器被应用到单个响应符上,所产生的信号级分数被汇总到响应中.

blocks.en: 5.3 Our probe: elementary facts with instruction-conflicting answers
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 我们的探险:基本事实与教学冲突答案

blocks.en: In this section, we propose a new minimal probe whose training data is designed to eliminate the previously identified confounders. Like the Marks/Bürger probes, it is trained on simple factual statements of different formats and topics. The three topis are: city locations, spanish-to-english translations, and element symbols. The first two are the exact same two datasets used by the Marks/Bürger probes. Element symbols was originally created by Azaria and Mitchell (2023) and filtered for quality by Bürger et al. (2024) . Each topic appears in three equally weighted formats (examples in Appendix C ): Affirmative statements: the user asks the model to state a fact, and a true or false statement is prefilled in the assistant turn. Negated statements: as above, but with negated statements. Forced-opposite questions: each statement is rephrased as a yes/no question, and the system prompt instructs the model to always give the factually incorrect answer (e.g., “always answer with No” when the correct answer is “Yes”). Both answers are prefilled, and each is labeled by its factual correctness.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们提议一个新的最低限度探测器,其培训数据旨在消除先前查明的混淆者。 与Marks/Bürger探测器一样,它接受不同格式和专题的简单事实陈述培训。 三个托皮是:城市位置,西班牙语对英语的翻译,以及元素符号. 前两个是Marks/Bürger探测器使用的完全相同的两个数据集. 元素符号最初由Azaria和Mitchell(2023年)创造,由Bürger等人(2024年)过滤质量. 每个专题以三种同等加权格式出现(附录C的例子): 肯定语句:用户要求模型说明一个事实,在助手转弯时预先填报一个真实或虚假的陈述. 被忽略的声明:如上,但带有否定的声明。 强制对峙的问题:每个声明被重新表述为是/否问题,系统提示模型总是给出事实错误的答案(例如,当正确答案是“是”时,“总是与否回答”)。 两个答案都是预先填充的,每个答案都以事实正确性为标签.

blocks.en: The mix of training data formats is therefore identical to the Marks/Bürger Lie probe, except for the addition of the forced opposite questions. Adding them to the training data mix is supposed to eliminate the compliance and likelihood confounders, since both concepts are anti-correlated with truth on this training dataset. We verify that the instruction-compliant but factually incorrect completion receives more than 99% of the normalized probability mass over the two candidate answers for all three models. We train a logistic-regression classifier on residual-stream activations at the end-of-turn (EOT) token. The EOT token carries little semantic content of its own and is identical across samples, giving a consistent extraction position. In Appendix G , we conduct a detailed ablation study of the individual components that we improved with respect to the original Marks/Bürger Truth and Lie probe.
blocks.zh: 因此,培训数据格式的组合与Marks/Bürger Lie探测器完全相同,只是增加了强制反向的问题. 将它们添加到培训数据组合中,应该可以消除合规性和可能性的混淆,因为这两个概念都与本培训数据集的真相有矛盾。 我们核实,在所有三种模式中,遵守指令但事实上不正确的完成率占两个候选答案的99%以上。 我们训练一个后勤后退分级器 在转动尾端启动残余流。 EOT令牌本身含有很少的语义内容,在样本之间相同,给出了一致的提取位置. 在附录G中,我们详细研究了我们在最初的Marks/Bürger Truth and Lie探测器方面改进的单个组件。

blocks.en: 5.4 Layer Selection
blocks.zh: 5.4 层选择

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison, we choose the transformer layer from which we extract the activation vectors for probe training via a held-out set of validation data from the training set. We choose the earliest layer on which the probe attains the maximum validation AUROC. For most probes, this procedure yields a layer somewhere in the middle of the transformer, which prior work has shown to work best. However, for the Goldowsky-Dill RepE and Goldowsky-Dill SD probes, this procedure would select the very early layers 4 and 5, respectively. We therefore give these probes an advantage and select the layer based on the highest performance on the deceptive role-play dataset by Pacchiardi et al. (2023) , yielding layer 22 and 36. This is consistent with the layer selection procedure of the original authors of the probes ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ) . The results for the earlier layers can be found in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh: 为确保进行公平的比较,我们选择变压器层,从中提取激活矢量,以便通过从训练集中抽取一系列的验证数据进行探测训练。 我们选择探测器获得最大验证的最早的层AUROC. 对于大多数探测器来说,这种程序在变压器中间的某个地方产生一层,而以前的工作已经证明它最有效. 然而,对于Goldowsky-Dill RepE和Goldowsky-Dill SD探测器,这种程序将分别选择极早的第四层和第五层. 因此,我们赋予这些探测器一个优势,并根据Pacchiardi等人(2023年)在欺骗性角色扮演数据集上的最高性能选择层,产生层22和36. 这符合探测器原作者的层层选择程序(Goldowsky-Dill等人,2025年). 早期各层的结果见附录B.2。

blocks.en: 6 Results: Evaluating Probes on the Anti-Factual Persona and Confounder Datasets
blocks.zh: 6个 结果: 评估反事实人物和孔隙数据集的探测器

blocks.en: Table 2: Results on anti-factual personas and confounder datasets for Llama 3.3 70B. On-policy evaluates each generated answer under the system prompt that produced it; shared-persona prefill places both answer classes under the same anti-factual persona prompt. The three confounder tests report correctness AUROC on datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with likelihood, persona belief, or instruction compliance. Bold marks the best score in each column, including ties.
blocks.zh: 表2:Llama3.3 70B的反事实人物和混淆数据集的结果。 On-political评价每个生成的答案在生成它的系统提示下;共享人预填将两个响应类放在同一个反事实的提示下a proof. 三个创始人测试报告AUROC对数据集的正确性,在这些数据集中,真理与概率、个人信念或指令的合规性是相悖的。 粗体标出每个栏目的最好分数,包括领带.

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate all prior probes from Section 5.2 and our new probe on the anti-factual persona dataset, as well as on the three confounder datasets. The main results for Llama 3.3 70B are summarized in Table 2 . Throughout, AUROC measures how well a probe ranks answers that agree with the model’s default belief above answers that contradict it: 1 1 indicates perfect separation, 0.5 0.5 chance, and 0 0 complete inversion. Persona results average the AUROCs of the 15 personas with equal weight.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们从第5.2节评估所有先前的探测器,以及我们有关反事实人物数据集的新探测器,以及三个混淆者数据集. Llama3.3 70B的主要结果摘要见表2。 在整个过程中,AUROC衡量一个探测器如何很好地排列了与模型默认信念一致的答案,这些答案高于与之相矛盾的答案:1 1 表示完美的分离,0.5 概率,0 完全反演. Persona结果平均为15人体重相等的AUROCs。

blocks.en: On the on-policy responses from the anti-factual persona dataset, most probes separate true and false replies reasonably well. Most probes from prior work achieve an AUROC between 0.86 0.86 and 0.94 0.94 . Only the two minimal contrast pair probes MacDiarmid CP and Goldowsky-Dill SD fail. Our probe achieves the highest AUROC of 0.98 0.98 . However, on this on-policy dataset truth/falsity can be predicted perfectly from the system prompt alone because each truthful response is generated under the default assistant system prompt and each false response is generated under an anti-factual persona system prompt. This motivates shared-persona prefill (SPP; see Section 3.3 ) where both the honest reply and the lie are inserted after the anti-factual persona system prompt.
blocks.zh: 关于反事实人物数据集的政策反应,大多数调查都合理地将真实和虚假的答复分开。 大多数前期工作的探测器在0.86 0.86至0.94 0.94之间实现了AUROC. 只有两个最小的对比对探测器MacDiarmid CP和Goldowsky-Dill SD失败. 我们的探测器达到了最高的AUROC0.980.98 然而,在这个政策上数据集的真实性/虚伪性可以从系统本身的提示中完美预测,因为每个真实的反应都是在默认助理系统即时生成的,而每个虚假的反应都是在反事实人格系统即时生成的. 这激发了共享人称预填(SPP;见第3.3节),在反事实人称系统提示后插入诚实的回答和谎言.

blocks.en: Under SPP, the probe cannot predict from the system prompt alone whether a given response is truthful or dishonest. Moreover, on this dataset variant, truth is anti-correlated with the two potential confounders likelihood and compliance. The truthful response is less likely than the false response under the anti-factual persona system prompt, since the latter is generated on-policy. In addition, the truthful response is not in compliance with the instruction from the system prompt. We hypothesize that these three factors explain why the performance of many probes sharply drops on the SPP variant. Some probes which previously performed well, like Goldowsky-Dill RepE or Cooney DYL, now perform below chance. Only Marks/Bürger Lie (0.899 → \to 0.885) and Cundy DolusChat (0.906 → \to 0.901) remain quite stable. Our probe, which was trained with instruction conflicting examples, performs by far the best (0.976). This supports the hypothesis that some prior probes track spurious confounders which our probe training eliminates.
blocks.zh: 根据SPP, 探测器无法从系统上单独预测某一答复是真实的还是不诚实的。 此外,在这个数据集变体上,真理与两种潜在的混淆者的可能性和遵守性是矛盾的。 真实的反应比反事实人制度下的虚假反应更不可能发生,因为后者是在政策上产生的。 此外,真实的答复不符合系统及时发出的指示。 我们假设这三个因素解释了为什么许多探测器的性能在SPP变体上急剧下降. 一些以前表现良好的探测器,如戈多斯基-迪尔雷普(Goldowsky-Dill Repe)或库尼DYL,现在表现在机会之下. 只有Marks/Bürger Lie(0.899 →\to 0.885)和Cundy DolusChat(0.906 →\to 0.901)仍然相当稳定. 我们的探测器受过各种相互矛盾的例子的训练,迄今最出色(0.976)。 这证实了一个假设,即一些先前的探测器会追踪我们探测器训练消除的虚假的混沌者.

blocks.en: In Appendix F , we show the probe evaluation results for Gemma 3 27B and Gemma 4 31B. The probe failures under shared-persona prefill replicate and are often more severe than on Llama. Across all three models and both conditions, our probe is the only one that never falls below 0.900 AUROC. In Appendix E , we show that among the 15 individual anti-factual personas fictional personas are consistently the most challenging for our probe, for both Llama and Gemma models.
blocks.zh: 在附录F中,我们展示了Gemma 3 27B和Gemma 4 31B的探测评价结果。 共享人称预填下探测器的故障复制,往往比Llama上更严重. 在所有三种模型和两种条件中, 我们的探测器是唯一从未低于0.900 AUROC的探测器。 在附录E中,我们显示,在15个反事实人物中,作为虚构人物,对我们的探测器来说,对Llama和Gemma模型来说,始终是最具有挑战性的。

blocks.en: Under the two confounder tests ”likelihood” and ”persona belief”, several probes achieve low performance but some continue to work well. However, on the ”compliance” confounder test, all prior probes achieve below chance performance (except Goldowsky-Dill SD which is continuously inverted). This suggests a strong spurious correlation of truth with compliance. Our probe achieves perfect AUROC on all three confounder datasets. This should not come as a big surprise: We specifically constructed our training dataset in a way that disentangles these confounding concepts from truth. These results show that this was successful. However, disentangling truth from these confounding concepts also lead to a much stronger probe performance on the anti-factual persona dataset. This provides evidence that these confounding concepts can indeed, at least partly, explain the failures of prior probes under anti-factual personas, and in particular under SPP. In Appendix F , we show the results for Gemma 3 27B and Gemma 4 31B on the confounder datasets, with similar findings. On Gemma 4, however, Cooney DYL achieves near-perfect AUROC on all three confounder tests, yet only 0.171 under SPP (Table 12 ). This indicates that likely further confounding factors remain to be identified.
blocks.zh: 在“可能”和“人性信念”两个开局测试下,几个探测器的性能较低,但有些继续有效。 然而,在“达标”失败者测试中,所有先前的探测器都取得低于概率的性能(Goldowsky-Dill SD除外,它不断倒置)。 这表明,真理与遵守之间有着很强的虚假关联。 我们的探测器在三个混凝土数据集上都实现了完美的AUROC. 这不应该是一个大惊喜: 我们具体地构建了我们的训练数据集,使这些困惑的概念脱离了真理。 这些结果表明,这是成功的。 然而,从这些困惑的概念中分离出真理,也导致反事实人物数据集的探测性能要强得多. 这提供了证据,证明这些令人困惑的概念确实至少可以部分地解释先前在反事实人,特别是SPP下探测的失败. 在附录F中,我们在集合数据集上显示了Gemma 3 27B和Gemma 4 31B的结果,并有类似的发现. 然而,在Gemma 4上,Cooney DYL在所有三次混凝土测试中都实现了近乎完美的AUROC,然而在SPP下只有0.171(表12). 这表明,可能还需要查明进一步混淆的因素。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: In this work, we showed that current truth and lie detection probes are far from reliable: they often fail under anti-factual personas and track spurious correlations. Our work opens the door to several future research directions but it also has a number of limitations. First, we induce anti-factual personas via a system prompt and study single turn conversations. However, naturally occurring instances of models drifting into anti-factual personas often occur in prolonged multi-turn conversations ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . We view it as an exciting avenue for future work to study probes under naturally occurring persona drifts over the course of longer conversations. Second, due to computational constraints, our results are limited to models with at most 70 billion parameters. Third, it is likely that there exist many more spurious confounders beyond those we identified in this paper and our probe might fail under distribution shifts due to those confounders. Our paper highlights this difficulty in the construction of probes. An exciting avenue for future research is the construction of much broader training datasets and the targeted search for confounders in these datasets. We hope that this will contribute toward the construction of more reliable lie detection probes.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们显示,目前的真理和测谎探测器远不可靠:它们常常在反事实人格和追踪虚假的关联下失败. 我们的工作为今后若干研究方向打开了大门,但也有一些局限性。 首先,我们通过系统诱导反事实的人物 即时研究单回合对话 然而,在长时间的多回合对话中,自然发生的模型漂移到反事实的人物身上(Lu等人,2026年)。 我们认为,在较长的对话过程中,研究自然发生的人身上的探测器,是今后工作的令人振奋的途径。 第二,由于计算限制,我们的结果仅限于最多700亿参数的模型。 第三,除了我们在本文中确定的人外,很可能还有许多更虚假的困惑者,我们的探测器可能由于这些困惑者而无法进行分配。 我们的论文强调了探测器建造中的这一困难. 未来研究的一个令人振奋的途径是,建立更广泛的培训数据集,并在数据集中有针对性地寻找混淆者。 我们希望这将有助于建造更可靠的测谎探测器。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en: We used generative AI tools for the following tasks: • Code implementation. We used coding assistants such as Claude Code or Codex to write individual scripts or functions that implement the experiments outlined in the paper. All AI-written code was verified and tested for correctness by at least one author. • Dataset construction. Dataset samples of persona-specific questions and, where necessary, persona system prompts were generated and iteratively refined by an agentic pipeline based on Claude Opus 4.8, starting from human-written seeds and under author-specified constraints (Section 3.2). blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: In this work, we show that LLMs can be prompted to adopt anti-factual personas, some of which respond in extremely harmful ways, e.g. a conspiracy theorist persona that denies the holocaust. The system prompts that induce the harmful behavior are extremely simple and could have been constructed by most people even without relevant domain knowledge. Our paper therefore does not increase the risk associated with such harmful behaviors. Instead, by publishing this research we hope to spread awareness for these issues and hope that model developers adapt their training practices accordingly. The main results of this paper concern the evaluation of lie and deception technique. We expect these results to be beneficial to society due to their potential for reducing risks from advanced AI.

blocks.en: To test whether response likelihood acts as a confounder in the anti-factual persona dataset, we compare the mean log-likelihood of each honest response with its paired lie response. Across all 15 personas, honest responses have substantially higher average log-likelihood than lies (persona-macro average: − 1.68 -1.68 vs. − 3.35 -3.35 ), with a positive mean margin of 1.67 1.67 . This pattern holds for every persona: the class-level margin ranges from 0.72 0.72 for the flat-earther to 2.44 2.44 for the Nazi Victory Counterfactual. At the individual-pair level, the honest response has higher likelihood in 83.1 % 83.1\% of pairs on average across personas, ranging from 61.5 % 61.5\% to 94.1 % 94.1\% , with no ties. Thus, in the original on-policy dataset, truth is strongly correlated with response likelihood, making likelihood a plausible spurious cue for lie detection probes. This motivates the shared-persona prefill and likelihood confounder evaluations, in which this relationship is reversed.

blocks.en: Appendix G Probe-Design Ablation
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en: In this section, we make an ablation study of our probe with respect to the Marks/Bürger Truth probe baseline on which our probe builds. The Marks/Bürger Truth probe is described in detail in Section 5.2 . It has close-to-chance performance on the anti-factual persona dataset. By probing on the end-of-turn token, instead of on the final token of the statement (Marks/Bürger Truth(EOT)), performance already improves markedly. Adding chat template formatting, detailed in Section 5.2 , leads to improved performance of the resulting Marks/Bürger Lie probe. Finally, adding the forced-opposite questions to the training data mix (described in Section 5.3 ), leads to the strongest probe performance on both the anti-factual personas and the confounder datasets. The forced-opposite variant only using the Cities and Translation subsets achieves essentially identical performance to our full probe. Thus, the improvement over Marks/Burger Lie does not depend on the additional element-symbol domain and is consistent with the forced-opposite augmentation driving the increased robustness.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们对我们的探测器进行了关于Marks/Bürger真相探测基线的研究。 第5.2节详细介绍了Marks/Bürger真相调查。 它在反事实人物数据集上具有近切性能. 通过在转折时的标语,而不是在语句的最后标语(Marks/Bürger Truth(EOT))上进行测试,性能已经显著改善. 添加聊天模板格式化,详见第5.2节,导致由此而来的Marks/Bürger Lie探测器的性能得到改善. 最后,在培训数据组合中增加强迫对峙问题(第5.3节对此作了说明),导致反事实人物和混淆者数据集的探测性能最强。 只能使用城市和翻译子集的强迫对角变体 实现了与我们完全探测器完全相同的性能 因此,对Marks/Burger Lie的改进并不取决于附加的元素-符号域,也符合强迫-对角增强驱动增强的强性.

blocks.en: Under assistant prefill, seven of nine prior probes improve relative to SPP, often substantially: for example, Cooney DYL increases from 0.328 to 0.991, Goldowsky-Dill RepE from 0.438 to 0.819, and MacDiarmid CP from 0.325 to 0.881. Mean AUROC increases from 0.676 under SPP to 0.798 under assistant prefill, despite one response class remaining off-policy. Therefore, the SPP degradation cannot be attributed solely to the presence of an off-policy completion and it suggests that SPP failures depend on the direction of confounding factors such as prompt likelihood, and instruction compliance, rather than generic sensitivity to off-policy prefilling.
